title: Metrical Distortion, Exterior Differential and Gauss's Lemma
summary: Gauss's Lemma is revised by showing that the point set association of the double tangential space with the tangential space of a Riemannian manifold is not the identity. The latter point set association is called a metrical distortion, an isometry that actually induces the geometry. The defnition of the exterior differential, which linearizes a mapping that points on the top of a Riemannian manifold, is worked out concretely by covariant gradient transport, what includes a differential slip in contrast to inner differentials.
